title: Speak
author: Laurie Halse Anderson
summary: Melinda starts high school as an outcast after calling the police at a summer party. She barely speaks, and finds a way to express herself through the art class she is assigned.
readIf: you want a short, honest novel about trauma and recovery with real emotional impact.
skipIf: you are sensitive to stories involving sexual assault.

pairings.reason: Another young adult novel about school and an assault, with a bleaker outlook.
An adult classic about a young woman's withdrawal and breakdown, told with sharp observation.
A teen story where friendship and writing become part of healing.
